I can see the issue - the pod is receiving SIGTERM while still loading the index shards into memory. The readiness probe is configured with a 0s delay (it starts immediately), but the pod takes about 9-15+ seconds to load the shards and start the HTTP listener. Since the readiness probe fails before the application is ready, Kubernetes terminates the pod, and the cycle repeats.
